summary: Full E2E validation of new multi-tenant frontend wiring (org onboarding gate, OrgSwitcher, MembersDialog) + backend org endpoints regression. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_orgs.py (unauth 401, auditor scoped GETs, no-org user 409, org create+switch, isolation empty fleet, invites pending/immediate/bad-email, last-owner guards). Frontend Playwright verified 7/7 core flows: (1) no-org user sees org-onboarding, creates org, lands in dashboard with switcher showing new org name; (2) auditor dashboard shows OrgSwitcher 'SentinelGrid Demo' + role OWNER; (3) switcher menu opens, Manage members opens MembersDialog listing auditor; (4) invite non-existing email creates pending invite (revocable, verified); (5) invite existing user (neworg@) added immediately as member; (6) switcher > New organisation shows OrgOnboarding with 'back to dashboard' button; (7) unauth /dashboard redirects to /login. Test data (TEST_ orgs, pending invites, neworg memberships) cleaned up.

issues: A11y warning: Radix DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` — console warning only, not blocking. Consider adding <DialogDescription> for screen readers.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to MembersDialog for a11y (Radix warning in console).
critical_code_review_comments: orgs.py cleanly separates owner-only mutations via ensure_owner(); last-owner protection is enforced on both role-demote and remove — verified.

context.py returns 409 (not 401) when authed user has no active org — this is the correct semantic and the frontend Dashboard.jsx handles it by rendering OrgOnboarding based on empty orgs list (not on 409). Works because /api/orgs/me is public-to-authed-user and returns empty orgs, so dashboard never reaches a 409 for a no-org user during initial load. Good.
OrgSwitcher pick() reloads window on switch — simple & reliable but heavier than a state refresh; acceptable for now.
Invite endpoint auto-accepts if email matches an existing user by looking up db.users by email — correct short-circuit. Case is normalised to lower() before lookup.
Superadmin path in /api/orgs/me lists ALL orgs but role falls back to 'owner' if no membership exists — matches product intent.
Dashboard.jsx orgStatus state machine (loading/none/ready) prevents refresh() firing before an org is active — no thrashing calls to /api/devices.
test_credentials: Auditor (with org_demo): Bearer test_session_auditor_01 / cookie session_token=test_session_auditor_01 (user_testauditor01). No-org user: Bearer test_session_neworg_01 (user_neworg01). Both re-seeded during this run.
